name: MPC / multi-sig hot wallets
description: All hot wallets controlled by an MPC scheme or multi-sig (m-of-n).

name: >95% of customer assets in cold storage
description: Documented split with daily reconciliation; bulk of assets offline.

name: Key generation + rotation ceremony
description: Documented multi-party ceremony, video-recorded, with rotation cadence and incident-recovery drill.

name: On-chain analytics screening
description: Every inbound and outbound address screened against sanctions/mixer/darknet labels via licensed provider.

name: Behavioural transaction monitoring rules
description: Documented rules with thresholds for layering, peeling, structuring, velocity; SAR workflow.

name: Threshold-based SoF / SoW procedure
description: Documented thresholds + evidence catalogue; PEP/EDD escalation; quarterly QA review.

name: Travel-rule protocol + counterparty registry
description: TRP / OpenVASP integration with counterparty list and inbound/outbound exception handling.

name: Trade surveillance
description: Automated wash-trading / spoofing / insider detection on all listed pairs; alerts triaged daily.

name: Tiered velocity limits + deposit aging
description: New customers capped on deposit/withdrawal; fiat deposits aged for chargeback window.

name: Pre-listing due diligence framework
description: Mandatory legal opinion + smart-contract audit + issuer KYC + market-abuse review before listing.
